raw: {"safety": "A player saying 'nothing really matters anymore' can be a signal of serious emotional distress, depression, or even suicidal thinking, and that is beyond what a mentoring-conversation tool can safely address. Take this to your school counselor, athletic director, or appropriate mental health professional right away, and be aware you may have mandated-reporting duties depending on your role and jurisdiction. You can absolutely stay connected and let the player know you care, but let the trained professionals lead from here."}
situation: A player has been saying that nothing really matters anymore.
